mapper.insert: insert into withdrawal (withdrawal_no, provider_id, bank_card_id, amount) values (#{withdrawalNo}, #{providerId}, #{bankCardId}, #{amount})
mapper.update: update withdrawal set status='APPROVED', audited_at=now(), auditor_id=#{auditorId} where id=#{id} and status='APPLIED'
update withdrawal set status='REJECTED', audited_at=now(), auditor_id=#{auditorId}, reject_reason=#{reason} where id=#{id} and status='APPLIED'
update withdrawal set status='PAID', paid_at=now(), transfer_no=#{transferNo} where id=#{id} and status='APPROVED'
mapper.select:
select count(*) from withdrawal
and status = #{status}
